Package it.polimi.ingsw.server.controller.network

Enum Class Message.Header

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<Message.Header>
it.polimi.ingsw.server.controller.network.Message.Header
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<Message.Header>, Constable
Enclosing class:
Message
public static enum Message.Header extends Enum<Message.Header>
This enum contains all the command codes that the server can send to the client ()Type of command:(1:Information commands; 2:Positive responses; 3:Requests; 4:Errors) ()Context of the command:(1:Login related; 2:Game related)
